title: फागुन २१ को चुनावी धक्का एमालेका लागि अस्थायी हो : विद्या भण्डारी
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेकपा एमालेकी वरिष्ठ नेता तथा पूर्वराष्ट्रपति विद्यादेवी भण्डारीले गत वर्ष फागुन २१ गतेको निर्वाचनमा पार्टीले व्यहोर्नुपरेको धक्का अस्थायी भएको बताएकी छन् । पार्टीको राष्ट्रिय भेलाको दोस्रो दिन सम्बोधन गर्दै नेता भण्डारीले अगुवा नेता तथा कार्यकर्तालाई निराश नभई नयाँ ऊर्जा, उत्साह र आत्मविश्वासका साथ अघि बढ्न आह्वान गरिन् । गत फागुन २१ गते सम्पन्न आमनिर्वाचनमा व्यहोर्नुपरेको धक्काबाट कार्यकर्तामा केही निराशा उत्पन्न भएको भए त्यसबाट मुक्त हुन आग्रह गर्दै उनले भनिन्, ‘एउटा निर्वाचनको हारले राजनीतिक आन्दोलनको भविष्य निर्धारण गर्दैन । निराश भएर निष्क्रिय बस्ने होइन, हारबाट सही पाठ सिक्दै र कमजोरी सच्याउँदै आगामी स्थानीय तहलगायतका निर्वाचनमा केन्द्रित हुनुपर्छ ।’ भण्डारीले सक्रिय राजनीतिमा आफ्नो पुनरागमनबारे स्पष्ट पार्दै आफू व्यक्तिगत पद, सुविधा वा अवसरका लागि नभई मातृ पार्टीको वैचारिक विकास, संगठनात्मक सुदृढीकरण र सामाजिक-आर्थिक रूपान्तरणमा योगदान पुर्‍याउन फर्किएको बताइन् । राष्ट्रपतिको सर्वोच्च संवैधानिक जिम्मेवारी सम्हाल्दा देशको सार्वभौमसत्ता, राष्ट्रिय स्वाभिमान, भौगोलिक अखण्डता तथा छिमेकी एवं मित्रराष्ट्रहरूसँगको सम्बन्ध प्रवर्द्धनमा भूमिका खेलेको उनले उल्लेख गरिन् । ‘मैले राष्ट्रपतिको सर्वोच्च ओहोदा हासिल गरिसकेकाले अब कुनै पनि पदप्रति लोभ छैन’, भण्डारीले भनिन् । मुलुकको शान्ति सुरक्षामाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न खडा भएको भन्दै उनले कार्यपालिका, न्यायपालिका र व्यवस्थापिकाबीचको शक्ति सन्तुलनमा प्रतिकूल प्रभाव पर्दा देशको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय छविमा आँच आउन थालेको टिप्पणी गरिन् । समयमै यसको निराकरण नभए मुलुक अस्थिरता र अनिश्चिततातर्फ धकेलिन सक्ने उनको चिन्ता थियो । जननेता मदन भण्डारीद्वारा प्रतिपादित जनताको बहुदलीय जनवाद (जबज) लाई भाषण र दस्तावेजमा मात्र सीमित नराखी दैनिक व्यवहार, निर्णय प्रक्रिया र संगठन सञ्चालनमा उतार्नुपर्नेमा उनले जोड दिइन् । आवश्यकताभन्दा पनि मागका आधारमा कमिटीहरूलाई ठूलो र भद्दा बनाउने प्रवृत्ति अन्त्य गरी कमिटीलाई मानार्थ नभई कार्यकारी बनाउन, आलोचना र आत्मालोचनाको पद्धति अपनाउन तथा सादगी जीवनशैली अवलम्बन गर्नुपर्ने भण्डारीको तर्क थियो । त्यसैगरी, युवा पुस्तामा बढ्दो निराशा, बेरोजगारी र विदेश पलायन रोक्न जनसंगठनहरूले उद्यमशीलता विकास, बहस तथा रचनात्मक अभियान चलाउनुपर्ने उनले बताइन् । निर्वाचित जनप्रतिनिधिहरूले शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, कृषि, रोजगारी र सुशासनका क्षेत्रमा पारदर्शी ढंगले काम गर्नुपर्ने वरिष्ठ नेता भण्डारीको धारणा छ । Kathmandu. Senior CPN-UML leader and former President Bidya Devi Bhandari has said that the setback the party suffered in the elections on Falgun 21 last year was temporary. Addressing the second day of the party's national gathering, leader Bhandari called on the leading leaders and cadres to move forward with new energy, enthusiasm, and confidence rather than despair. Urging the cadres to get rid of any disappointment they may have experienced due to the setbacks they faced in the general elections held on February 21, she said, "One election defeat does not determine the future of a political movement. Instead of remaining passive and disappointed, we should focus on the upcoming local level elections, including those at the local level, by learning the right lessons from the defeat and correcting our weaknesses." Bhandari clarified her return to active politics, saying that she returned not for personal position, privilege, or opportunity, but to contribute to the ideological development, organizational strengthening, and socio-economic transformation of her mother party. She mentioned that while assuming the supreme constitutional responsibility of the President, she played a role in promoting the country's sovereignty, national pride, geographical integrity, and relations with neighboring and friendly countries. "Since I have achieved the highest office of President, I am no longer greedy for any position," Bhandari said. Stating that serious questions have arisen regarding the country's peace and security, she commented that the country's international image is beginning to be tarnished due to the adverse impact on the balance of power between the executive, judiciary and legislature. She was concerned that if this is not resolved in time, the country could be pushed towards instability and uncertainty. She emphasized that the people's multi-party democracy (JABAZ) propounded by public leader Madan Bhandari should not be limited to speeches and documents but should be implemented in daily behavior, decision-making processes, and organizational operations. Bhandari argued that the trend of making committees large and bulky based on demand rather than necessity should be ended, and committees should be made executive rather than honorary, adopting a method of criticism and self-criticism, and adopting a simple lifestyle. Similarly, she said that public organizations should develop entrepreneurship, conduct debates and launch creative campaigns to prevent growing despair, unemployment and emigration among the young generation. Senior leader Bhandari believes that elected representatives should work transparently in the fields of education, health, agriculture, employment and good governance.

गर्नुपर्ने वरिष्ठ नेता भण्डारीको धारणा छ । Kathmandu. Senior CPN-UML leader and former President Bidya Devi Bhandari has said that the setback the party suffered in the elections on Falgun 21 last year was temporary. Addressing the second day of the party's national gathering, leader Bhandari called on the leading leaders and cadres to move forward with new energy, enthusiasm, and confidence rather than despair. Urging the cadres to get rid of any disappointment they may have experienced due to the setbacks they faced in the general elections held on February 21, she said, "One election defeat does not determine the future of a political movement. Instead of remaining passive and disappointed, we should focus on the upcoming local level elections, including those at the local level, by learning the right lessons from the defeat and correcting our weaknesses." Bhandari clarified her return to active politics, saying that she returned not for personal position, privilege, or opportunity, but to contribute to the ideological development, organizational strengthening, and socio-economic transformation of her mother party. She mentioned that while assuming the supreme constitutional responsibility of the President, she played a role in promoting the country's sovereignty, national pride, geographical integrity, and relations with neighboring and friendly countries. "Since I have achieved the highest office of President, I am no longer greedy for any position," Bhandari said. Stating that serious questions have arisen regarding the country's peace and security, she commented that the country's international image is beginning to be tarnished due to the adverse impact on the balance of power between the executive, judiciary and legislature. She was concerned that if this is not resolved in time, the country could be pushed towards instability and uncertainty. She emphasized that the people's multi-party democracy (JABAZ) propounded by public leader Madan Bhandari should not be limited to speeches and documents but should be implemented in daily behavior, decision-making processes, and organizational operations. Bhandari argued that the trend of making committees large and bulky based on demand rather than necessity should be ended, and committees should be made executive rather than honorary, adopting a method of criticism and self-criticism, and adopting a simple lifestyle. Similarly, she said that public organizations should develop entrepreneurship, conduct debates and launch creative campaigns to prevent growing despair, unemployment and emigration among the young generation. Senior leader Bhandari believes that elected representatives should work transparently in the fields of education, health, agriculture, employment and good governance.

पार्टीको राष्ट्रिय भेलाको दोस्रो दिन सम्बोधन गर्दै नेता भण्डारीले अगुवा नेता तथा कार्यकर्तालाई निराश नभई नयाँ ऊर्जा, उत्साह र आत्मविश्वासका साथ अघि बढ्न आह्वान गरिन् । गत फागुन २१ गते सम्पन्न आमनिर्वाचनमा व्यहोर्नुपरेको धक्काबाट कार्यकर्तामा केही निराशा उत्पन्न भएको भए त्यसबाट मुक्त हुन आग्रह गर्दै उनले भनिन्, ‘एउटा निर्वाचनको हारले राजनीतिक आन्दोलनको भविष्य निर्धारण गर्दैन । निराश भएर निष्क्रिय बस्ने होइन, हारबाट सही पाठ सिक्दै र कमजोरी सच्याउँदै आगामी स्थानीय तहलगायतका निर्वाचनमा केन्द्रित हुनुपर्छ ।’ भण्डारीले सक्रिय राजनीतिमा आफ्नो पुनरागमनबारे स्पष्ट पार्दै आफू व्यक्तिगत पद, सुविधा वा अवसरका लागि नभई मातृ पार्टीको वैचारिक विकास, संगठनात्मक सुदृढीकरण र सामाजिक-आर्थिक रूपान्तरणमा योगदान पुर्‍याउन फर्किएको बताइन् । राष्ट्रपतिको सर्वोच्च संवैधानिक जिम्मेवारी सम्हाल्दा देशको सार्वभौमसत्ता, राष्ट्रिय स्वाभिमान, भौगोलिक अखण्डता तथा छिमेकी एवं मित्रराष्ट्रहरूसँगको सम्बन्ध प्रवर्द्धनमा भूमिका खेलेको उनले उल्लेख गरिन् । ‘मैले राष्ट्रपतिको सर्वोच्च ओहोदा हासिल गरिसकेकाले अब कुनै पनि पदप्रति लोभ छैन’, भण्डारीले भनिन् । मुलुकको शान्ति सुरक्षामाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न खडा भएको भन्दै उनले कार्यपालिका, न्यायपालिका र व्यवस्थापिकाबीचको शक्ति सन्तुलनमा प्रतिकूल प्रभाव पर्दा देशको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय छविमा आँच आउन थालेको टिप्पणी गरिन् । समयमै यसको निराकरण नभए मुलुक अस्थिरता र अनिश्चिततातर्फ धकेलिन सक्ने उनको चिन्ता थियो । जननेता मदन भण्डारीद्वारा प्रतिपादित जनताको बहुदलीय जनवाद (जबज) लाई भाषण र दस्तावेजमा मात्र सीमित नराखी दैनिक व्यवहार, निर्णय प्रक्रिया र संगठन सञ्चालनमा उतार्नुपर्नेमा उनले जोड दिइन् । आवश्यकताभन्दा पनि मागका आधारमा कमिटीहरूलाई ठूलो र भद्दा बनाउने प्रवृत्ति भनिन् । मुलुकको शान्ति सुरक्षामाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न खडा भएको भन्दै उनले कार्यपालिका, न्यायपालिका र व्यवस्थापिकाबीचको शक्ति सन्तुलनमा प्रतिकूल प्रभाव पर्दा देशको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय छविमा आँच आउन थालेको टिप्पणी गरिन् । समयमै यसको निराकरण नभए मुलुक अस्थिरता र अनिश्चिततातर्फ धकेलिन सक्ने उनको चिन्ता थियो । जननेता मदन भण्डारीद्वारा प्रतिपादित जनताको बहुदलीय जनवाद (जबज) लाई भाषण र दस्तावेजमा मात्र सीमित नराखी दैनिक व्यवहार, निर्णय प्रक्रिया र संगठन सञ्चालनमा उतार्नुपर्नेमा उनले जोड दिइन् । आवश्यकताभन्दा पनि मागका आधारमा कमिटीहरूलाई ठूलो र भद्दा बनाउने प्रवृत्ति अन्त्य गरी कमिटीलाई मानार्थ नभई कार्यकारी बनाउन, आलोचना र आत्मालोचनाको पद्धति अपनाउन तथा सादगी जीवनशैली अवलम्बन गर्नुपर्ने भण्डारीको तर्क थियो । त्यसैगरी, युवा पुस्तामा बढ्दो निराशा, बेरोजगारी र विदेश पलायन रोक्न जनसंगठनहरूले उद्यमशीलता विकास, बहस तथा रचनात्मक अभियान चलाउनुपर्ने उनले बताइन् । निर्वाचित जनप्रतिनिधिहरूले शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, कृषि, रोजगारी र सुशासनका क्षेत्रमा पारदर्शी ढंगले काम गर्नुपर्ने वरिष्ठ नेता भण्डारीको धारणा छ ।

काठमाडौं । नेकपा एमालेकी वरिष्ठ नेता तथा पूर्वराष्ट्रपति विद्यादेवी भण्डारीले गत वर्ष फागुन २१ गतेको निर्वाचनमा पार्टीले व्यहोर्नुपरेको धक्का अस्थायी भएको बताएकी छन् ।

पार्टीको राष्ट्रिय भेलाको दोस्रो दिन सम्बोधन गर्दै नेता भण्डारीले अगुवा नेता तथा कार्यकर्तालाई निराश नभई नयाँ ऊर्जा, उत्साह र आत्मविश्वासका साथ अघि बढ्न आह्वान गरिन् ।

गत फागुन २१ गते सम्पन्न आमनिर्वाचनमा व्यहोर्नुपरेको धक्काबाट कार्यकर्तामा केही निराशा उत्पन्न भएको भए त्यसबाट मुक्त हुन आग्रह गर्दै उनले भनिन्, ‘एउटा निर्वाचनको हारले राजनीतिक आन्दोलनको भविष्य निर्धारण गर्दैन । निराश भएर निष्क्रिय बस्ने होइन, हारबाट सही पाठ सिक्दै र कमजोरी सच्याउँदै आगामी स्थानीय तहलगायतका निर्वाचनमा केन्द्रित हुनुपर्छ ।’

भण्डारीले सक्रिय राजनीतिमा आफ्नो पुनरागमनबारे स्पष्ट पार्दै आफू व्यक्तिगत पद, सुविधा वा अवसरका लागि नभई मातृ पार्टीको वैचारिक विकास, संगठनात्मक सुदृढीकरण र सामाजिक-आर्थिक रूपान्तरणमा योगदान पुर्‍याउन फर्किएको बताइन् ।

Kathmandu. Senior CPN-UML leader and former President Bidya Devi Bhandari has said that the setback the party suffered in the elections on Falgun 21 last year was temporary. Addressing the second day of the party's national gathering, leader Bhandari called on the leading leaders and cadres to move forward with new energy, enthusiasm, and confidence rather than despair. Urging the cadres to get rid of any disappointment they may have experienced due to the setbacks they faced in the general elections held on February 21, she said, "One election defeat does not determine the future of a political movement. Instead of remaining passive and disappointed, we should focus on the upcoming local level elections, including those at the local level, by learning the right lessons from the defeat and correcting our weaknesses." Bhandari clarified her return to active politics, saying that she returned not for personal position, privilege, or opportunity, but to contribute to the ideological development, organizational strengthening, and socio-economic transformation of her mother party. She mentioned that while assuming the supreme constitutional responsibility of the President, she played a role in promoting the country's sovereignty, national pride, geographical integrity, and relations with neighboring and friendly countries. "Since I have achieved the highest office of President, I am no longer greedy for any position," Bhandari said. Stating that serious questions have arisen regarding the country's peace and security, she commented that the country's international image is beginning to be tarnished due to the adverse impact on the balance of power between the executive, judiciary and legislature. She was concerned that if this is not resolved in time, the country could be pushed towards instability and uncertainty. She emphasized that the people's multi-party democracy (JABAZ) propounded by public leader Madan Bhandari should not be limited to speeches and documents but should be implemented in daily behavior, decision-making processes, and organizational operations. Bhandari argued that the trend of making committees large and bulky based on demand rather than necessity should be ended, and committees should be made executive rather than honorary, adopting a method of criticism and self-criticism, and adopting a simple lifestyle. Similarly, she said that public organizations should develop entrepreneurship, conduct debates and launch creative campaigns to prevent growing despair, unemployment and emigration among the young generation. Senior leader Bhandari believes that elected representatives should work transparently in the fields of education, health, agriculture, employment and good governance.
